📋 Creator Agreement
Studyria Creator Program — Terms & Conditions 1. Revenue Share: Creators earn a percentage of each sale based on their tier: Starter (60%), Rising (65%), Pro (70%), Elite (75%). Studyria retains the remaining platform fee.

2. Content Ownership: You retain full ownership of your PDFs. By uploading, you grant Studyria a non-exclusive license to sell and distribute your content on the platform.

3. Originality: All uploaded PDFs must be your original work. Plagiarized or copied content will result in immediate removal and account suspension.

4. Quality Standards: PDFs must meet a minimum quality score of 60/100 as evaluated by our Smart Verification system.

5. Withdrawals: Minimum withdrawal threshold is ₹500. Payments are processed within 7 business days via bank transfer or UPI.

6. Anti-Spam: Duplicate PDF submissions are automatically detected and rejected. Repeated violations result in account suspension.

7. Level Upgrades: Creator levels are auto-upgraded based on total sales. Rising: ₹5,000+ · Pro: ₹25,000+ · Elite: ₹1,00,000+

8. Approval Process: All applications and PDFs are reviewed by the Studyria admin team within 3–5 business days.

9. Tax Compliance: Creators are responsible for their own income tax on earned revenue. Studyria will provide earnings statements on request.

10. Studyria reserves the right to modify these terms with 7 days prior notice.
